questions.q: Why did Black Beauty think some change was coming at the start of the chapter?
choices: The groom cleaned and dressed him with extraordinary care
questions.evidence: the groom cleaned and dressed me with such extraordinary care that I thought some new change must be at hand

questions.q: Why was the tall, pale lady nervous about Black Beauty?
choices: He had once been down and might fall again
He was too big for her carriage
questions.evidence: she should always be nervous in riding behind a horse that had once been down

questions.q: Mr. Thoroughgood says, "Handsome is that handsome does." What does this mean?
choices: How a horse behaves matters more than how he looks
A horse must be groomed every day

questions.q: Which mark made the groom sure the horse was Black Beauty?
choices: The little patch of white hair John called "Beauty's three-penny bit"
questions.evidence: that little patch of white hair that John used to call 'Beauty's three-penny bit'

questions.q: Who was the groom at Black Beauty's last home?
questions.evidence: little Joe Green, that almost killed you

questions.q: What did the ladies decide after Black Beauty proved safe for a week or so?
choices: To keep him and call him by his old name, Black Beauty
To send him back to Mr. Thoroughgood
To sell him to a cab owner
questions.evidence: it was quite decided to keep me and call me by my old name

questions.q: How does Black Beauty's story end?
choices: He is safe and happy, and his ladies promise never to sell him
He is sold again to a cab owner
He goes back to the war
questions.evidence: My ladies have promised that I shall never be sold
